summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals, including enhancements to the REST Catalog specification and the introduction of finer-grained access policies. Additionally, there are ongoing efforts to improve CI runner efficiency and address transactional support in the batch load API.
highlights: Integration updates with Spark and removal of Spark 3.4 support
Proposal for file-level access delegation in the REST Catalog Spec
Discussion on incremental flushing of data files to manifests during commits
Need for cross-implementation conformance testing framework
